title: Kompromat
text: A folder of photographs no one was meant to see. Suddenly a rival is feeling very generous.

title: The Wiretap
text: You've been listening for weeks. Tonight you cash in what you heard.

title: Honey Trap
text: The charming new aide on a rival's staff files two reports a week. One goes to them. One comes to you.

title: Slush Fund Raid
text: Enforcement agencies knock on a rival's door at dawn with a very specific warrant. You wrote the specifics.

title: Character Assassination
text: By morning the whole country knows the worst version of your opponent. By evening they've forgotten it isn't true.

title: The Saboteur
text: Their star campaign manager has a gambling debt. You bought it. He works for you now — badly, for them.

title: Booth Capture
text: Your men hold the polling station for twenty crucial minutes. The queue outside never knew.

title: Midnight Purge
text: The rolls are 'corrected' in the dead of night. A voter simply stops existing on paper.

title: Engineered Defection
text: A ward that was never really loyal finds a better offer waiting in a hotel room.

title: Cross the Aisle
text: One handshake, one envelope, and a voter changes colours between breakfast and lunch.

title: Model Code Freeze
text: You invoke a rule so obscure the commission has to look it up. The constituency locks solid while they do.

title: Poll Embargo
text: No surveys, no rallies, no movement in this district. Orders from the top. You are the top.

title: Exit Poll Leak
text: You get tomorrow's numbers today. The pollster gets a consulting contract next year.

title: Media Blitz
text: Every screen in the country, your face, all weekend. The invoice is billed to a trust that doesn't exist.

title: War Chest
text: The quiet donors come through when it matters. They always do. They always will. They always want something.

title: Astroturf Movement
text: A 'spontaneous' citizens' uprising, complete with hand-painted signs from a print shop you own.

title: Street Muscle
text: Nothing says grassroots like a few hundred hired fists at every corner tea stall.

title: Rig the Rolls
text: You don't like the cards on the table, so you have the table changed.

title: The Censor's Stamp
text: A friendly official decides today's offerings are 'unsuitable for public display'. New ones arrive shortly.

title: Double Agent
text: Your man on the inside brings back more than you asked for. You stop asking where it comes from.

title: The Old Network
text: One phone call to a number you've kept for twenty years. Favours, it turns out, compound like interest.

title: Leak the Plot
text: You saw it coming and fed the story to the press first. REACTION: cancel a conspiracy played against you.

title: Counter-Intelligence
text: Your people were inside their operation before it had a name. REACTION: cancel a conspiracy played against you.

title: Plausible Deniability
text: It never happened, and you have the paperwork to prove it. REACTION: cancel a conspiracy played against you.
